Does Brad Pitt die in Deadpool 2?

He plays Vanisher, a cameo role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

Yes. Electrocuted on power lines, visible for about one second.

The invisible mutant Vanisher joins Deadpool's new X-Force team for a parachute drop onto a prison convoy. High winds scatter the team and kill them one by one; Vanisher is blown into high-voltage power lines and electrocuted, his face flickering into view for a split second to reveal it was Brad Pitt all along. Only Deadpool and Domino survive the jump.

Uncredited surprise cameo; Pitt shot it in about two hours for scale. The same footage appears in the PG-13 recut Once Upon a Deadpool (2018). Deadpool's time-travel fix at the end saves Peter but not Vanisher.
